# PoolCup

> PoolCup is a private World Cup 2026 prediction pool app. Create a pool for your office, group chat, or friends; invite members with a link; everyone predicts match scores before kickoff; the app scores predictions and updates live leaderboards automatically.

## What it does

- Create a paid private pool ($15 one-time per pool creator)
- Share an invite link so members can join
- Predict scores for group stage and knockout matches
- Automatic scoring and leaderboard rankings after results are final
- Built for the FIFA World Cup 2026 tournament (72 matches)

## Authenticated areas (not for public indexing)

Member-only flows such as `/dashboard`, `/create`, `/pool/{invite_code}`, and `/join/{invite_code}` require an account and/or a pool invite code.

## Contact

- Support email: support@poolcup.app
- Contact form: https://www.getpoolcup.com/contact

## Tech summary

- Web app: Next.js (React), hosted as a modern SPA/SSR site
- Auth & data: Supabase
- Payments: Stripe (pool creation)
